description: Defines classes and structures related to MTP (Media Transfer Protocol) properties, including MtpProperty and MtpPropertyValue, with methods for handling property data, types, and forms.

classes.name: MtpProperty
classes.description: Represents an MTP property with attributes such as code, type, value, and form, and methods to manipulate these properties.

classes.name: MtpPropertyValue
classes.description: Union structure to hold different types of property values, including a string pointer for UTF8 strings.

methods.name: MtpProperty(MtpPropertyCode, MtpDataType, bool, int)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor for initializing a property with code, type, writability, and default value.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the property.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads property data from an MtpDataPacket.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes property data to an MtpDataPacket.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value from a UTF8 string.

methods.name: setCurrentValue
methods.description: Sets the current value from a UTF8 string or MtpDataPacket.

methods.name: setFormRange
methods.description: Sets the property form as a range with min, max, and step.

methods.name: setFormEnum
methods.description: Sets the property form as an enumeration with specified values.

methods.name: setFormDateTime
methods.description: Sets the property form as a date/time.
